settings.heading: Why Choose The Klawford Athens Divan Bed?

settings.title: 60 Night Risk-Free Trial
settings.description: We're so confident you'll love your Athens bed that we offer a full 60-night risk-free trial. Not satisfied within the first 60 nights? Contact us for a hassle-free return or swap — no questions asked.

settings.title: Extra Storage Option For More Space
settings.description: Make the most of your bedroom with the Athens Divan's optional drawer storage. Choose from 2 drawers on the left or right side to keep your bedroom organised and clutter-free.

settings.title: Sustainably Sourced & Handmade in The UK
settings.description: Every Klawford Athens Divan is handcrafted in Britain using sustainably sourced timber and premium upholstery fabrics — built to last a lifetime and designed to impress.

settings.title: Customisable & Beautiful Headboards
settings.description: The Athens comes with a stunning upholstered headboard as standard, perfectly matched to your chosen fabric colour to create a seamless, luxury bedroom look.

settings.title: Compatible With All Mattress Types
settings.description: The Athens Divan base works perfectly with memory foam, pocket spring, hybrid, latex and orthopaedic mattresses — giving you total freedom to choose your ideal sleep surface.

settings.question: Do your products conform to UK fire safety regulations?
settings.answer: Yes — all Klawford products fully comply with UK fire safety regulations including BS 7177. Our factory holds all required certifications.

settings.question: How long does delivery take once I've placed my order?
settings.answer: Standard delivery is 7–14 working days. You'll receive full tracking information once dispatched. Our 2-man team will contact you to arrange a convenient delivery slot.

settings.question: Can I choose my delivery date and time?
settings.answer: Yes — once your order is ready to dispatch, our delivery partner will contact you to arrange a convenient date and time window that suits you.

settings.question: Can I place my order over the phone?
settings.answer: Yes — our sleep specialists are available to take your order by phone. Call us at 0800 000 0000 and we'll guide you through the options and handle your order directly.

settings.question: What is the 60-night risk-free trial?
settings.answer: We're so confident in our products that we offer a 60-night risk-free trial. If you're not completely satisfied within the first 60 nights, contact us for a full refund or free replacement — no questions asked.

settings.question: What does the 5-year warranty cover?
settings.answer: Our 5-year warranty covers all manufacturing defects, structural issues and material faults. Contact our customer service team with your order number and we'll handle your claim promptly.

settings.question: Can I pay monthly or through financing options?
settings.answer: Yes — we offer 0% interest financing through Klarna and other providers at checkout. Split your purchase into manageable monthly instalments with no hidden fees.

settings.question: Where are your products manufactured?
settings.answer: All Klawford products are handcrafted in the United Kingdom using sustainably sourced materials. We're proud to support British manufacturing.
